claims.statement: On the integer 3-cycle, a gauge-fixed potential satisfies |f| <= C ||df||_{1,w} with C = 1/min(w) under positive integer weights.
dependencies: Integer 3-cycle graph topology with positive integer weights.
Path bound expressing vertex potentials via accumulated edge coboundary differences.
claims.limits: Formulated for the discrete integer 3-cycle with positive integer weights; does not claim arbitrary infinite complexes or non-gauge-fixed potentials.

claims.statement: On Z^3 with positive weights ||x|| = sum w_e |x_e| is positive definite, and residual representatives add subadditively; zero weight is refused.
dependencies: Three-edge integer cochain space with positive integer weights.
Termwise triangle inequality on absolute values.
Linearity of the coboundary and residual operators under potential addition.
claims.limits: Applies to ambient cochain norm and supplied residual representatives; does not define the minimized quotient norm.

claims.statement: For a finite graph with positive weights and conjugate exponents 1/p + 1/q = 1, strong Fenchel-Rockafellar duality establishes Phi_p(c) = max { <y, c> : d_0^T y = 0, ||y||_{q, w^*} <= 1 } with zero duality gap.
dependencies: Finite graph with strictly positive edge weights.
Quotient infimum attainment on the gauge-fixed complement (AUDIT-N001-001).
claims.limits: Applies to finite graphs with positive weights; zero duality gap relies on finite dimensionality and non-empty interior of the continuous primal norm domain.
